article.title: Presumption as to due execution, etc., of documents not produced
article.content:
91Presumption as to due execution, etc., of documents not produced

Section 91 · Part III · Chapter V · Presumptions as to documents
The Court shall presume that every document, called for and not produced after notice to produce, was attested, stamped and executed in the manner required by law.
